items.title: The AI trade cracks: stocks have their worst day since April 2025
items.summary: Two days after Democrats swept Congress, fears of a crackdown on AI data centers sent the Nasdaq down 5.5% into a correction, the S&P 500 down 4.4% and the Dow down 1,833 points, the worst day for all three since the April 2025 tariff shock. Nvidia fell more than 9% and AMD 17%, and the Nasdaq 100's 6.4% drop was its worst since March 2020 ("BREAKING" from Unusual Whales, 14K likes). The timeline coped with jokes: Zero Hedge priced the wipeout at "almost 3 Elons" (6K), and Bryan Johnson posted himself bathing in the red glow of a stock heatmap, "always improving my protocol" (28K). The same day in London, Russell Brand was found guilty of one count of rape and three of sexual assault.
